title: Motion (Blumenfield - Hutt) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning and the Department of Building Safety, with the assistance of the City…
text:
[Council File 17-0274-S3]
Motion (Blumenfield - Hutt) relative to instructing the Department of City Planning and the Department of Building Safety, with the assistance of the City Administrative Officer, and in consultation with the City Attorney, to prepare and present an ordinance to amend the Affordable Housing Linkage Fee (Los Angeles Municipal Code Sections 19.18 and 16.02) to allow for a refund after construction has started but never completed, and a Certificate of Occupancy never obtained, up to $35,000 for single family home projects.
(This item is referred to the Housing Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee. The Housing Committee approved this item as amended on September 8, 2026.)
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For if Amended: Palms Neighborhood Council
summary: Prepare ordinance allowing refund of Affordable Housing Linkage Fees up to $35,000 for single-family home projects that never obtain occupancy.

details.action: Amend Affordable Housing Linkage Fee refund provisions

outcome.text: Planning and Land Use Management Committee concurred with the recommendation of the Housing Committee (Sep 22, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Oct 6, 2026); Council action final
